What consultants do: from a vague complaint to a clear problem

Two routes

Companies can look for the cause in two ways.

People are quitting. Why?

In-house

  • Led by HR or the operations team
  • Uses exit interviews, surveys and internal data
  • Works when the team has strong data skills and time

Consultants

  • For messy, sensitive or unclear issues
  • Bring outside objectivity and expert tools
  • Turn vague complaints into clear action

Usually HR looks first. Consultants come in when the company can't find or fix the cause itself.

Try it

Which route fits each situation?

  • HR has a strong people-analytics team, and its data already shows exits jump on one shift.

  • Complaints are vague, the topic is sensitive, and leaders disagree about the cause.

What consultants do

Consultants don't jump to quick fixes. They investigate, then state the problem clearly.

“Something feels off. Too many people are leaving.”

Illustrative example, not real data.

Why it works

A statement like that tells leaders three things.

  • Whois affected
  • How muchit's happening
  • Where to looknext
